encoding.unionLossCellDeltas: first differences along the closing year, restarting at each opening year; add them up to recover the union
encoding.knownForestCellsByStartYear: one number per opening year; the denominator does not move as the span widens
encoding.unknownCellsByStartYear: one number per opening year, on the same grounds
encoding.summedLoss: not stored; add annualLossCells across the span. It has no denominator and never carries a percentage.
